title: Microwave Meringues
description: Magical microwave meringues made from icing sugar and egg white — watch them puff up in the microwave in under a minute. Serve with passion fruit or berries.

ingredients.text: 3 passion fruit or a punnet of fresh berries, to serve

steps: Sift the icing sugar into the egg white and mix roughly with a wooden spoon (do not whisk). Knead with your hands until combined and even — texture should be thick paste.
Cut a circle of greaseproof paper to fit the microwave turntable.
Arrange 2 balls on the paper, well spaced. Heat for 40–60 seconds, watching closely — stop when they look big enough.
Cool on a wire rack. Repeat for the rest of the batch.
Serve drizzled with passion fruit seeds and juice, or crumbled into whipped cream and berries.
notes: Makes 15 large meringues. Per meringue estimate (excluding berries). Handle carefully — the intense heat makes them very fragile.
